decision: G8 bounded local development failure policy accepted; no claim of full filesystem preservation

chosen_semantics.deadline: Hard deadline kills task container; no time extension for post-deadline reads
chosen_semantics.no_output_inference: Missing captured file is not evidence it never existed
chosen_semantics.already_captured_evidence: Host RPC model/tool receipts, platform log, entrypoint snapshots and images retained, individually hash-listed
chosen_semantics.score: null; classification requires evidence review; no automatic scientific zero
chosen_semantics.not_promised: Periodic backups or arbitrary tmpfs recovery; imported dependencies history and full filesystem completeness

implementation: Only failure-record path/helper and cleanup exception handling changed. Successful execution/collection/harness/task budget logic unchanged. Audit failures/cleanup failures cannot replace active primary exception; cleanup error remains separately recorded.

error.message: Container session unavailable or deadline exhausted

limitations: Task deadline and daemon cleanup have bounded nonzero overhead; observed elapsed is reported, not rounded into an exact zero-latency kill.
A failure during host audit writing can prevent complete failure.json; original exception survives and carries note where supported.
No periodic artifact backups; container tmpfs may disappear after timeout.
This test validates chosen lifecycle semantics; it is not complete scientific, judge, transport or formal security acceptance.
